'''Heavy Troopers''' were a kind of [[infantry/Legends|infantry]] used by The Rebel Alliance. 

== History ==
Some time between 0.5 ABY and [[3 ABY/Legends|3]] [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] started using Heavy [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]]. They were frequently carried into battle on the ship [[Rusty Eagle]]. They were also employed by the then Rebel [[Brenn Tantor]] after his defection from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], serving under Rebel General [[Tyr Taskeen]].  

== Equipment ==
They wore a type of exoskeletal load bearing backpack harness to hold and utilize heavy guns. 

== Training and Skills ==
They were trained to operate larger hand held [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]. 

== Behind the Scenes ==
The Heavy Troopers were created for the game ''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]].''
